Why Should You Work at Zoot Web Agency?

Since 2015, Zoot Web Agency has been a reliable digital marketing partner, helping businesses do well online with services that focus on results and strong relationships with clients. Because growth is at the heart of everything we do, we support it in all fields.

This team moves forward because they are creative, work together, and are dedicated to doing their best. We would love to hear from you if you are interested in creative marketing and helping brands reach their full potential.

Learn More About us

We are hiring for positions in organic social, SEO, paid media, and consulting right now. The job of our organic social media strategist is to create content, build communities, and grow audiences on all platforms by running organic campaigns.

Our team gets benefits, growth, and rewards.

We care about our workers, are honest with them, and work hard to build our team. With flexible PTO, you can take time off whenever it works for you. Deep work is always respected when you have protected focus blocks and hours that work for you.

Two ways to stay healthy are to get health insurance and get help with your mental health. A dedicated learning budget pays for classes, conferences, and time with a mentor, which means that your Careers at Zoot Web Agency will always be moving forward.

With our remote-first setup, you can work from anywhere, and we’ll pay you to set up your home office.

1

First Talk with Our Talent Team

The first step in your journey is to talk to our recruitment team. This step helps us learn about your skills, experience, and career goals, and it also gives you a chance to learn more about Zoot Web Agency, our culture, and how we do things.

2

Meet the founder and the people in charge

The founder and leaders of Zoot Web Agency invite a select group of people to a virtual meeting. During this session, we talk about our story, mission, values, and long-term goals. After that, there will be a chance for everyone to talk and ask questions.

3

Everyone on the team should be interviewed

You will have a planned interview with members of our core team. Through this group discussion, we can see how well you can communicate, solve problems, and work as a team, which are three important qualities we look for at Zoot Web Agency.

4

Review of Skills and Culture Fit

Finalists will either take a test or do a task that is specific to the job. You will also meet with the team leaders in person to talk about what they expect from you, how things work, and how your skills fit with our culture and projects.

5

Choosing the best candidate and making an offer

We make our final choice after carefully reviewing and getting feedback from within. Successful candidates receive an offer and begin their journey with Zoot Web Agency ready to grow, collaborate, and build impactful digital solutions with us.

Team stories

Get to know the people who did the work.

Voices from real people on our team. A few short notes about what it’s like to work here, how we work together, and what growth looks like in real life.

How we've grown and made a difference over the years

Zoot Web Agency has grown into a trusted digital marketing partner for businesses of all sizes since we started. Brands have been able to consistently grow their digital presence, get more qualified leads, and get more exposure thanks to data-driven strategies, creative solutions, and measurable results.

We have added SEO, PPC, social media, content marketing, and web development to our list of services over the years. Now, successful campaigns cover a wide range of industries and locations, thanks to a team that is focused on client success, innovation, and strategy.

Working at Zoot Web Agency, a digital marketing company, means joining a team with a history of success and a clear plan for how to keep growing in the future.
